title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
summary: Choose one day to buy and a strictly later day to sell.

contractDetails.constraints: The prices array has 1–100,000 entries in [0, 10,000], in chronological order.

statement: Choose one day to buy and a strictly later day to sell. Return the largest possible profit. Return zero if skipping the trade is at least as good as every allowed trade.

examples.explanation: Buying at 2 and selling at 8 earns 6.
The first price and the last price give the largest gain.

constraints: The prices array has 1–100,000 entries in [0, 10,000], in chronological order.
hints: Conceptual: For any selling day, only the cheapest earlier price matters.
Directional: Carry the best purchase price seen so far as you scan.
Implementation: Compare each price with the earlier minimum before updating that minimum. Keep the best gain, starting at zero.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space. One pass maintains two numbers.
